description: Epoch bundled model latency/throughput calibration table (MODEL_CALIBRATIONS). Every entry is stamped data: measured_at (ISO date the entry's values were last set or measured) + provenance (kind + source). These are CALIBRATION values (tokensPerSecond, reasoningOverheadMs, toolCallLatencyMs), NOT pricing; pricing lives in data/supplementary-database.json modelCalibration. Provenance stamping landed 2026-09-24 WITHOUT changing any value; refreshed_at therefore still tracks the last VALUE refresh (2026-07-09, the Phase 5 model-catalog refresh) so age/staleness surfaces stay honest.

sources.curatedBenchmarks: Latency/throughput figures curated from the supplementary-DB llmBenchmarks source class (data/supplementary-database.json sources.llmBenchmarks): Artificial Analysis, BenchLM.ai, LLMversus, SaltTechno, official provider pages; table last value-refreshed at the 2026-07-09 Phase 5 model-catalog refresh. These are curated aggregates, not fresh primary-source re-measurements.
sources.claudePhase5Placeholders: claude-haiku-4-5, claude-opus-4-8, claude-sonnet-5, claude-fable-5 carry latency/throughput figures COPIED from a same-tier sibling entry (see each entry's provenance.source) — NOT primary-source verified, pending real telemetry. Their PRICING is primary-source verified separately (data/supplementary-database.json sources.claudeModelPricingPhase5).
sources.publicRefreshClass: Approved zero-cost refresh sources between releases: public benchmark/spec pages of the Artificial Analysis class plus community records conforming to data/schemas/model-calibration.schema.json. Refresh procedure: scripts/refresh-model-calibrations.mjs (fail-closed) documented in docs/MODEL-CALIBRATION-REFRESH.md.
